'''Winsafra Generals and Admirals, or, the Empires Best(whicher you prefer :P)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 28 July 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Deal Winsafra DS 2003 Generals.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

my strongest deck i ever built, glad to bring it back now that i got an executor again, but i do gotta admit, it came off Jay's idea, so if he see's this, thanks again  :)

== Strategy ==

New:

Just to let ya know man, i run Crush because cloud city is all mobile sites(they get no more than 2 battle destinies). and i HATE defensive shields, so i wont play with them.

if i do take crush out it'll be to put sando aqua monster in so my opponent cant play colo claw fish :)

thanks for the advice though!

Basic Stategy is getting dark deal/cc occupation set up as quickly as possible. try and get the executor out first turn if possible, and get guri up there pronto!!!

and yes i know there's only 3 Cloud City sites in here and no docking bays, thats because i want it to be as hard as possible to cancel dark deal(they have to go to space or cloud city to cancel it because i only have 3 sites!). and the generals and admirals hold each direction with imperial commands(we're in attack position is in for more direct damage if tagge or veers are holding the ground.)anywho, lemme know what you all think!
